problem:
A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with acceleration $a(t)=4{sec}^{2}⁡t,$ where $a(t)$ is measured in ${\text{ft/s}}^{2}$ and $t$ is measured in seconds. Find the speed of the particle at the moment $t=\frac{\pi }{4}\,\text{s}$ given that the particle has velocity $v=\frac{1}{2}\,\text{ft/s}$ when $t=0\,\text{s}.$

The speed at the moment $t=\frac{\pi }{4}\,\text{s}$ is
{{field-1}} $\,\text{ft/s}.$
